svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — 3, 2, 1… please take a number
svg.desc: Black-and-white pen-and-ink newspaper cartoon. On a palm-lined beach beside the sea at Bowen, a rocket stands ready on its launch tower, with cobwebs on its engine and a countdown board reading T-minus: pending. In front, a fictional public servant at a folding table, half-hidden behind a towering in-tray of paperwork, raises a rubber stamp and says the launch window is open 9 to 4, weekdays, except today. A weary fictional engineer in a hard hat and hi-vis vest holds out ticket number 4,812 beneath a Now Serving No. 12 sign, while two fictional locals in camp chairs with an esky and a sleeping dog wait to watch.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
Source: ABC News, 17 November 2026 — A rocket launch from Bowen is pencilled in for December, pending federal approval.
